system.name: Weights file and a vendor model that updates silently
system.description: Scoped assessment of L5 AI Model Provider. A public-hub weights file is tuned in house under IaaS, so that asset is customer-owned. A vendor model can move to version v2026-12 with no customer approval. Under AI-SaaS the customer cell is N/A, and the customer relies on the provider's attestation. These results feed the holistic view.
